relations.name: bdj_raw_responses
relations.comment: CP-04A original model output, encrypted at rest. Distinct from bdj_results.result_payload (the validated structured result). Never returned by general Activity History responses; readable only by the audit role.

relations.name: bdj_result_findings
relations.comment: Links a cloud BDJ result to the candidate findings it produced. A row asserts one thing only: this result produced this finding, at candidate authority. Because finding_id is NOT NULL and references public.m2_bdj_findings, a rejected or held finding -- which has no such row -- cannot appear here. The reason a result produced no finding lives on the parent row as review_outcome plus review_reason, never here: there is no per-finding free-text justification column, because an unconstrained text field in an append-only table is an invitation to record a rationale nobody validates. authority is fixed at 'candidate' because a model-assisted result can never produce a verified finding; independent review is required for that and is enforced outside this table.

relations.name: bdj_results
relations.comment: CP-04A validated cloud-BDJ result. One row per attempt. Carries provenance, the structured result, and the four independent outcome dimensions (execution_outcome, generated validation_status, review_outcome, finding_authority). Holds no raw prompt and no completion text. result_payload DOES contain entrepreneur answer text: each finding carries Finding.source_refs[].quote, a verbatim substring of the declaration it cites. A History reader must therefore never return result_payload wholesale: it may project only the non-quote fields (rule_id, kind, observed_condition, counterargument, justification, next_action) and must treat source_refs[].quote as protected content requiring the same handling as bdj_raw_responses.

relations.name: finding_provenance
relations.comment: Provenance for a persisted BDJ finding. A row asserts that this finding was produced by this execution, at candidate authority. finding_id is NOT NULL and references public.m2_bdj_findings, so a rejected or held finding -- which has no such row -- cannot appear here. Stores identifiers and digests only: no prompt, completion or provider payload.

relation_grants_note: Relations absent from this list have NULL relacl (default: owner-only). See relations[].relacl_raw.

columns.comment: Finding authority asserted by this cloud result. Single value candidate: a model-assisted result can never claim VERIFIED, which requires independent review (review_state='VERIFIED' with finding_hash, confirmation_id and review_event_id) enforced by BCB outside this schema.

Human-readable explanation of why this check passed or failed. May describe the failure; must never reproduce the quoted answer span, the prompt, or the provider body. Writers select from a fixed catalogue rather than interpolating content, because interpolated text is how answer quotes reach a column nobody is watching.

D1 provider/transport outcome. Owner: project1_ai.attempts.outcome, written by ledger.finish(). Values returned|rejected|unknown_outcome. Must equal the attempt receipt outcome (C5, enforced by the service: the value is copied from the ledger, never derived from the review).

The structured BDJ result: {"findings": [...]}. PROTECTED CONTENT -- the findings embed verbatim answer quotes in source_refs[].quote, so this column must not be projected wholesale to any reader. Return the non-quote fields only; treat the quotes like bdj_raw_responses ciphertext.

D3 BDJEngine.review() verdict. Owner: the engine return value. Values reviewed|rejected|stale, or NULL when the attempt was reserved but the provider never returned, so no review happened. reviewed means the engine completed; it never means the finding is true.

columns.column_default:
CASE
    WHEN (review_outcome IS NULL) THEN 'not_validated'::text
    WHEN (review_outcome = 'rejected'::text) THEN 'invalid'::text
    ELSE 'valid'::text
END
columns.comment: D2 structured-response validation outcome, generated from review_outcome: NULL->not_validated, rejected->invalid, otherwise valid. Generated because review() validates if and only if it dispatched, so an independently written value could only ever disagree with the review.
D4 authority this result may claim over its findings. Fixed at candidate_only: a model-assisted result can never be verified without independent review, which BCB enforces outside this table.
Number of findings in result_payload.findings. Stored so the derived state NO_ADMISSIBLE_FINDING is queryable without opening the JSONB payload.
Optional fixed reason code for the review outcome (for example CANDIDATE_VALIDATION_FAILED). Never provider text, prompt text or answer content.

Authority asserted over the finding. Single value candidate: a result may never claim VERIFIED here, which requires independent review (review_state, finding_hash, confirmation_id, review_event_id) enforced by BCB outside this schema. execution_mode records how the finding was produced; this column records what may be claimed about it.

views.name: m2_workflow_campaigns
views.definition:
SELECT c.assessment_id,
    c.owner_user_id,
    jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('campaign_id', c.id, 'release_id', c.release_id, 'manifest_hash', r.manifest_hash, 'source_class', r.source_class, 'sessions', ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM cq_sessions s
          WHERE s.campaign_id = c.id), 'receipts', ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM cq_submission_receipts t
             JOIN cq_sessions s ON s.id = t.session_id
          WHERE s.campaign_id = c.id)) ORDER BY c.id) AS campaigns
   FROM cq_campaigns c
     JOIN cq_manifest_releases r ON r.id = c.release_id
  GROUP BY c.assessment_id, c.owner_user_id;

views.name: m2_workflow_summary
views.definition:
SELECT a.id AS assessment_id,
    a.owner_user_id,
    a.revision,
    jsonb_build_object('assessment', jsonb_build_object('id', a.id, 'revision', a.revision, 'confirmed_revision', a.confirmed_revision, 'instrument_version', i.version_tag), 'review_events', COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', v.id, 'revision', v.assessment_revision) ORDER BY v.created_at, v.id) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM m2_review_events v
          WHERE v.assessment_id = a.id), '[]'::jsonb), 'clarifications', COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', v.id, 'revision', v.assessment_revision, 'finding', v.finding_id, 'decision', v.decision, 'sequence', v.event_sequence) ORDER BY v.assessment_revision, v.event_sequence) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM m2_clarification_events v
          WHERE v.assessment_id = a.id), '[]'::jsonb), 'confirmations', COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', c.id, 'revision', c.assessment_revision, 'digest', c.snapshot_digest) ORDER BY c.id) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM m2_confirmation_snapshots c
          WHERE c.assessment_id = a.id), '[]'::jsonb), 'contexts', COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', b.context_id, 'revision', b.assessment_revision, 'hash', b.packet_hash, 'status', b.lifecycle_status, 'attributes', b.packet_json #> '{business_description,source_question_ids}'::text[]) ORDER BY b.context_id) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM m2_business_contexts b
          WHERE b.assessment_id = a.id), '[]'::jsonb), 'builds', COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('confirmation', b.confirmation_id, 'revision', b.assessment_revision, 'status', b.status, 'reason', b.last_code, 'attempts', b.attempt_count) ORDER BY b.confirmation_id) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM m2_business_context_builds b
          WHERE b.assessment_id = a.id), '[]'::jsonb), 'bdj_evaluations', COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', e.id, 'revision', e.assessment_revision, 'rule_version', e.evaluator_version) ORDER BY e.id) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM m2_bdj_evaluations e
          WHERE e.assessment_id = a.id), '[]'::jsonb), 'findings', COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', f.id, 'revision', f.assessment_revision, 'type', f.issue_type, 'decision', f.review_state, 'sources', f.source_answer_ids) ORDER BY f.id) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM m2_bdj_findings f
          WHERE f.assessment_id = a.id), '[]'::jsonb), 'objectives', COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', u.id, 'revision', c.assessment_revision, 'confirmation', c.id, 'origin', s.provenance ->> 'origin'::text, 'parent', s.provenance ->> 'parent_objective_id'::text, 'exploration_used', s.provenance -> 'exploration_used'::text, 'limitation_recorded', l.objective_id IS NOT NULL, 'child', r.child_id) ORDER BY u.id) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM m2_confirmation_snapshots c
             JOIN m2_confirmed_uncertainties u ON u.confirmation_id = c.id
             JOIN m2_research_objective_sources s ON s.objective_id = u.id
             LEFT JOIN m2_research_clarifications l ON l.objective_id = u.id
             LEFT JOIN m2_research_revisions r ON r.parent_id = u.id
          WHERE c.assessment_id = a.id), '[]'::jsonb), 'candidates', COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', q.id, 'objective', u.id, 'revision', c.assessment_revision, 'supersedes', q.supersedes, 'desired_option', d.option_code, 'qj_route', receipt.data #>> '{evaluation,qj,route}'::text[], 'bank_outcome', receipt.data #>> '{evaluation,bank}'::text[], 'candidate_decision', receipt.data #>> '{evaluation,qg,decision}'::text[], 'source_version', receipt.data #>> '{candidate,source_version}'::text[], 'owner_decision', v.decision, 'decision_time', to_char((v.recorded_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'::text)) ORDER BY q.id) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM m2_confirmation_snapshots c
             JOIN m2_confirmed_uncertainties u ON u.confirmation_id = c.id
             JOIN m2_review_question_versions q ON q.objective_id = u.id
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT
                        CASE
                            WHEN q.source_receipt IS JSON OBJECT THEN q.source_receipt::jsonb
                            ELSE NULL::jsonb
                        END AS data) receipt
             LEFT JOIN m2_desired_options d ON d.question_version = q.id
             LEFT JOIN m2_candidate_owner_reviews v ON v.candidate_id = q.id
          WHERE c.assessment_id = a.id), '[]'::jsonb), 'campaigns', ( SELECT cq.campaigns
           FROM m2_workflow_campaigns cq
          WHERE cq.assessment_id = a.id AND cq.owner_user_id = a.owner_user_id), 'llm_execution', 'NOT_VERIFIED', 'scientific_review', 'NOT_VERIFIED', 'fielding', 'NOT_VERIFIED', 'report_admission', 'NOT_VERIFIED') AS summary
   FROM m2_assessments a
     JOIN m2_instrument_versions i ON i.id = a.instrument_id;

functions.name: cq_session_update_guard
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cq_session_update_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF ROW(NEW.id,NEW.campaign_id,NEW.release_id,NEW.respondent_user_id,NEW.locale,NEW.created_at)
    IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.id,OLD.campaign_id,OLD.release_id,OLD.respondent_user_id,OLD.locale,OLD.created_at)
    OR NEW.revision!=OLD.revision+1
    OR (OLD.state!='ACTIVE' AND NEW.state NOT IN (OLD.state,'WITHDRAWN')) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'CQ identity is immutable and revision transitions are controlled' USING ERRCODE='55000';
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cq_synthetic_can_execute(sid uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.cq_synthetic_cases x JOIN public.cq_synthetic_execution_grants g ON g.run_id=x.run_id
 WHERE x.session_id=sid AND x.session_id::text=current_setting('project1.synthetic_session_id',true)
 AND x.run_id::text=current_setting('project1.synthetic_run_id',true)
 AND g.developer_user_id::text=current_setting('project1.actor_id',true)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.cq_synthetic_import_retirements z WHERE z.run_id=x.run_id));
$function$

functions.name: cq_synthetic_profile_guard
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cq_synthetic_profile_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF (NEW.account_status<>'suspended' OR NEW.email_verified) AND
 (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.cq_synthetic_import_records WHERE table_name='users' AND record_key->>'user_id'=NEW.user_id::text)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.cq_sessions s JOIN public.cq_synthetic_cases x ON x.session_id=s.id WHERE s.respondent_user_id=NEW.user_id)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'SYNTHETIC_PROFILE_NOT_LOGIN_ACCOUNT' USING ERRCODE='42501';
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

functions.name: ee01_source_binding_guard
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ee01_source_binding_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE snap ee01_measurement_snapshots; BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO snap FROM ee01_measurement_snapshots WHERE id=NEW.snapshot_id;
 IF snap.id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cq_sessions s WHERE s.id=NEW.session_id AND s.campaign_id=snap.campaign_id)
 OR (NEW.render_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cq_render_events r WHERE r.id=NEW.render_id AND r.session_id=NEW.session_id AND r.slot_id=snap.slot_id))
 OR (NEW.answer_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cq_answer_revisions a WHERE a.id=NEW.answer_id AND a.session_id=NEW.session_id AND a.slot_id=snap.slot_id))
 OR (NEW.rejected_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cq_rejected_answer_events a WHERE a.id=NEW.rejected_id AND a.session_id=NEW.session_id AND a.slot_id=snap.slot_id)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'EE01 source binding mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

classification.rule: PROJECT1 = schema project1_ai, plus public relations named m2_* / cq_* / ee01_* or named assessment_workflow_projection. Everything else in public is foreign_to_project1.

foreign_to_project1_note: public is shared. No rental 'listing/booking/lease/payment' tables exist; the foreign set is the legacy SiteWise real-estate/listing application. public.users is the hard coupling point: 8 PROJECT1 foreign keys reference it.
